INTRODUCTION
Zyro Dynamics is committed to conducting its business with the highest standards of honesty, integrity, and
professionalism. This Code of Conduct defines the expected behaviour for all employees, contractors,
consultants, and interns across every Zyro Dynamics location, and while representing the company externally.
Adherence to this Code is a fundamental condition of employment. Employees are required to read, understand,
and sign an acknowledgement of this Code at the time of joining.
SCOPE AND APPLICABILITY
This Code applies to all individuals employed by or associated with Zyro Dynamics Pvt. Ltd., whether on a
full-time, part-time, contract, or internship basis. It governs conduct at the workplace, at client sites, during official
travel, at company-sponsored events, and in any digital or social media interaction that may be connected to the
company.
PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT
Workplace Behaviour
Every person at Zyro Dynamics has the right to work in an environment that is safe, respectful, and inclusive.
The following standards are expected from all employees without exception:

 Treat all colleagues, clients, vendors, and visitors with dignity and respect, regardless of their designation,
gender, age, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, or disability.
 Maintain professional tone and language in all communications, whether verbal, written, electronic, or in
person.
 Resolve workplace disagreements through respectful dialogue. Where a resolution cannot be reached, the
matter should be escalated to the reporting manager or HR.
 Refrain from using offensive or discriminatory language, sharing inappropriate content, or engaging in any
conduct that creates a hostile or uncomfortable environment.
Accountability
  Take ownership of your work and your commitments. Communicate proactively with your manager if a
deadline or deliverable is at risk.
 Be punctual for work, meetings, and client engagements. Habitual tardiness without a valid reason is a
disciplinary matter.
CONFLICTS OF INTEREST
A conflict of interest exists when an employee's personal interests, whether financial, professional, or personal,
could influence or appear to influence their decisions or actions in their role at Zyro Dynamics. The following
rules apply:
  Any real or potential conflict of interest must be disclosed in writing to the reporting manager and HR
immediately upon becoming aware of it.
 Employees must not hold a financial interest in a competitor, customer, or supplier without prior written
clearance from the Legal and Compliance team.
 If an immediate family member is employed by a competitor or vendor of Zyro Dynamics, this must be
disclosed to HR.
 Engaging in paid employment or consulting with another organisation while employed at Zyro Dynamics is
not permitted without prior written approval from the Chief People Officer.
CONFIDENTIALITY
Employees are entrusted with confidential information as part of their day-to-day responsibilities. This includes
customer and prospect data, product roadmaps, pricing, financial figures, HR records, business strategies,
source code, and any information not publicly disclosed.
  Confidential information must not be shared with any person who does not have an authorised business
need to access it.
 Company information must not be posted on social media, shared on personal devices, or disclosed to any
media outlet.
 On exit from the company, all confidential documents, access credentials, and company-issued assets must
be returned or deleted as directed by IT and HR.
 Violations of confidentiality may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination, and may attract
civil or criminal liability under applicable law.
Note: For detailed data classification and handling rules, refer to the IT and Data Security Policy — ZDL-IT-001.

SOCIAL MEDIA
Employees are free to maintain personal social media accounts. However, the following rules must be observed
when posting anything that could be connected to Zyro Dynamics:
  Do not share confidential company information, internal communications, client names, product screenshots,
or financial data on any social media platform.
 Do not make statements that could be interpreted as the official position of Zyro Dynamics unless expressly
authorised by the Marketing team.
 Negative commentary or criticism of colleagues, management, or clients on social media is prohibited and
may attract disciplinary action.
 When sharing professional opinions publicly, always include a personal disclaimer: Views expressed are my
own and do not represent Zyro Dynamics.
